test.fill_query: INSERT INTO FUNCTION file('test_parquet_prewhere_only_columns.parquet', Parquet) SELECT number AS k, toUInt32(number % 1000) AS w, concat('https://example.com/some/long/path/', toString(cityHash64(number)), '/index.html') AS u, if(number % 7 = 0, concat('search phrase ', toString(number)), '') AS s FROM numbers(50000000)
test.query: SELECT count() FROM file('test_parquet_prewhere_only_columns.parquet', Parquet) PREWHERE u != '' FORMAT Null
SELECT sum(w) FROM file('test_parquet_prewhere_only_columns.parquet', Parquet) WHERE u != '' FORMAT Null
SELECT k % 1000 AS g, count(), sum(w) FROM file('test_parquet_prewhere_only_columns.parquet', Parquet) WHERE s != '' GROUP BY g FORMAT Null
